attribution: Gonthier/Emery source semantics and planar hypermap Euler theorem

required_semantics: Initial bichromatic routes on the same exterior
Exact source edges and complete core stars
Planar disk rotation with ordered boundary

formal_results: Arbitrary proper fixed-pair history endpoints have a joint boundary normal form from retained initial routes; graph, palette, boundary and history sizes are unrestricted.
For the D0099 port colours and retained route profile, every fixed-pair phase leaves at least two necessary core omissions, for every interior recolouring and choice of omitted vertices.
An explicit 23-vertex exterior realizes all six route profiles simultaneously; reversed and equal pairs are included.
The exterior rotation is planar, its boundary has eleven distinct ordered ports, and its actual trace is Kempe-closed.
Two omitted core vertices suffice initially. The first two moves of the exhibited mixed-pair history still require at least two omissions.
Three actual component switches give a GSLT history and reconstruct a proper colouring of the whole 31-vertex graph.
program_only: Exact minimum-hole profile 2,2,2,0 (Lean proves the lower bounds at the first three states, an initial upper bound and final full reconstruction).
No single or double physical switch suffices on this exterior: 199 distinct states checked.
All 80 batches switching both complementary vertex-colour pairs of one XOR difference preserve the two-hole lower bound.
The glued 31-vertex graph is a triangulated sphere with minimum degree three.
limits: The example has degree-three vertices and does not certify an obstruction in the minimal-counterexample subclass.
Mixed-pair repair succeeds here; unrestricted repair and compact compositional proof are not refuted.
A mixed-pair structural continuation for arbitrary source inputs, strict ambient reduction, geometric supply and universal coverage remain open.
No runtime bound or compression of the complete proof is claimed.
